name: Grok 4.1 Fast
short: xAI's 2M-context 4.1 Fast tier at $0.20/$0.50 for high-volume tool calling; xAI lists grok-4-1-fast as an alias of the reasoning build; tau2 93.3% (reasoning) vs 63.7% (plain).
pricingNote: xAI native $0.20/$0.50 per 1M (cached $0.05); not on OpenCode Zen
standout: The tool-calling speed tier: 2M context at rock-bottom pricing, with a reasoning build that still tops tau2-bench.
tradeoff: The plain build has no deliberation - it executes plans, it does not make them; deprecated in favour of Grok 4.3.
